title_zh: 京张公共智证六段协议
author: 许丙南 / Codex
authority_boundary: This is a conceptual operating and spatial handoff, not a statutory plan, engineering design, procurement decision, safety case or government commitment.
ordinary_route_rule: Every AI-assisted window keeps a staffed, paper, phone or static wayfinding equivalent; the ordinary route remains usable during setup, test, failure and close-down.

stages.ai_role: cluster repeated questions and identify missing evidence
stages.ordinary_equivalent: paper form, phone line and walk-in desk
stages.evidence_output: question receipt with source, owner, place and requested response
stages.stop_condition: reject or hold an issue when source, accountable owner, consent or privacy boundary is unclear

stages.ai_role: display minimum data, test boundary, duration and responsible role
stages.human_role: rights, accessibility, safety, fire and maintenance gate review
stages.evidence_output: window card with consent, retention, appeal, deletion and stop fields
stages.stop_condition: do not open a window without a named owner, ordinary route, accessible route and maintenance response

stages.ai_role: provide explainable assistance, low-speed sensing or resource/route suggestions inside a sandbox
stages.human_role: spotter, operator, accessibility lead and site steward
stages.ordinary_equivalent: static signs, paper map, staffed service and manual inspection
stages.evidence_output: time-bounded receipt with inputs, incidents, near misses and recovery time
stages.stop_condition: stop on failed emergency stop/takeover, blocked public route, unsafe climate/water condition or unlogged data

stages.ai_role: offer traceable advice and compare alternatives; never issue a statutory, medical, legal or procurement decision
stages.human_role: two independent reviewers plus affected public correction path
stages.ordinary_equivalent: professional conversation, paper decision note and human appeal
stages.evidence_output: decision note naming evidence, uncertainty, dissent and next action
stages.stop_condition: hold when evidence cannot be reproduced, group harm appears or professional responsibility is missing

stages.ai_role: version a receipt, failure record and reusable component list
stages.human_role: rights steward, editor and contributor correction desk
stages.ordinary_equivalent: printed receipt, staffed explanation and opt-out/withdrawal form
stages.evidence_output: cleared record with author, source, license, hash, result and limitation
stages.stop_condition: hide or withdraw material when rights, attribution, deletion or limitation is unresolved

stages.ai_role: compare scale-up, redesign, ordinary fallback and retirement options
stages.human_role: asset owner, maintenance crew, finance and public-interest reviewer
stages.ordinary_equivalent: passive component, ordinary service and manual close-down
stages.evidence_output: change record with work order, cost band, climate trigger, complaint response and exit plan
stages.stop_condition: freeze expansion after overdue maintenance, climate/rule change, incident or unresolved complaint

stations.ordinary_route: static explanation, staffed review and no-device public path
stations.primary_gate: safety, climate, energy, rights and maintenance evidence

stations.ordinary_route: paper clinic, human service desk and non-digital learning route
stations.primary_gate: rights, consent, campus interface, accessibility and professional referral

stations.ordinary_route: static wayfinding, quiet route, staffed counter and manual event close-down
stations.primary_gate: resident access, fire, crowd, noise, drainage, privacy and return-to-normal

cross_cutting_gates: provisional geometry is never an official redline
wind, heat, air and water claims remain unknown until field evidence and professional review
no biometric identification, individual trajectory retention or unlicensed material
ordinary public route, human takeover, accessible route and complaint path remain available
maintenance owner, cost band, seasonal trigger and retirement path are visible before expansion
